fullPassage: The unity of science and philosophy in the old classical sense was perhaps best described by the famous tree of Descartes: The roots of this tree corresponded to metaphysics (the intelligible principles), the trunk to physics (statements of intermediate generality), and the branches and fruit to what we would call applied science. He regarded the whole system of science and philosophy as we today regard science alone; he felt that the metaphysical principles were ultimately justified by their “fruits,” not merely by their self-evidence. What we today call applied science consisted for him not only in mechanics but also in medicine and ethics. The difficulty was that from the general principles of Cartesian or Aristotelian science-philosophy no results could be derived which were precisely in agreement with observation, but these principles seemed to be intelligible and plausible. So the tree was cut in the middle. For the derivation of technical results, it was necessary to start from the physical principles in the trunk. Science in the new sense was to think only of how the fruits would develop from the trunk without regard to the roots.

❌ ① concealed: concealed(숨기다)는 도출과 반대로 감추는 의미
✅ ② obtained: obtained(얻다/획득하다)는 derived(도출하다/끌어내다)의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ③ abandoned: abandoned(버리다/포기하다)는 도출과 무관한 의미
❌ ④ restored: restored(복원하다)는 원래 상태로 되돌리는 것으로 도출과 다른 의미
det.tip: derived = obtained = 도출하다, 얻어내다

questions.passage: The unity of science and philosophy in the old classical sense was perhaps best described by the famous tree of Descartes: The roots of this tree corresponded to metaphysics (the intelligible principles), the trunk to physics (statements of intermediate generality), and the branches and fruit to what we would call applied science. He regarded the whole system of science and philosophy as we today regard science alone; he felt that the metaphysical principles were ultimately justified by their “fruits,” not merely by their self-evidence. What we today call applied science consisted for him not only in mechanics but also in medicine and ethics. The difficulty was that from the general principles of Cartesian or Aristotelian science-philosophy no results could be derived which were precisely in agreement with observation, but these principles seemed to be intelligible and <u>plausible</u>. So the tree was cut in the middle. For the derivation of technical results, it was necessary to start from the physical principles in the trunk. Science in the new sense was to think only of how the fruits would develop from the trunk without regard to the roots.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 plausible과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: plausible=그럴듯한/타당해 보이는 → reasonable=합리적인/타당한
det.analysis:
❌ ① profitable: profitable(수익성 있는)은 경제적 가치에 관한 단어로 그럴듯함과 다름
❌ ② permanent: permanent(영구적인)은 지속성에 관한 단어로 타당성과 다름
❌ ③ primitive: primitive(원시적인)은 발전 단계에 관한 단어로 그럴듯함과 다름
✅ ④ reasonable: reasonable(합리적인/타당한)는 plausible(그럴듯한/타당해 보이는)의 동의어 ←정답
det.tip: plausible = reasonable = 그럴듯한, 타당해 보이는

det.korean: general=일반적인 → specific=구체적인/특정한
det.analysis:
✅ ① specific: specific(구체적인/특정한)는 general(일반적인)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ② popular: popular(인기 있는)는 general과 의미축이 다름 (보편성 vs 인기)

questions.passage: The old oak <u>tree</u> in the park has been standing for over three hundred years, providing shade for generations of visitors. Descartes used the image of a <u>tree</u> to represent the entire system of knowledge: roots as metaphysics, the trunk as physics, and the branches as applied sciences.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 tree의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: tree: (A) 실제 나무 (오래된 참나무) / (B) 지식 체계를 나타내는 비유적 구조도
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 나무 — (B) 나무: (B)에서 tree는 실제 나무가 아닌 지식 체계의 비유적 표현
✅ ② (A) 나무 — (B) 체계도/구조의 비유: (A)는 공원의 실제 나무, (B)는 데카르트가 지식 체계를 표현하기 위해 사용한 비유적 구조도 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 계통 — (B) 나무: (A)는 계통이 아닌 실제 나무, (B)도 단순한 나무가 아닌 비유
❌ ④ (A) 수목 — (B) 가지: (A) 수목은 나무의 유의어이나, (B)는 가지가 아닌 전체 구조의 비유
det.tip: tree: ① (식물) 실제 나무 ② (비유) 체계도/구조 — 데카르트의 지식의 나무는 학문 체계를 비유한 것

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the process of arriving at a conclusion by reasoning from general principles or premises"

det.korean: derivation=도출/유도 (일반 원리에서 추론을 통해 결론에 도달하는 과정)
det.analysis:
❌ ① observation: observation(관찰)은 감각을 통한 인지로, 추론을 통한 도출 과정과 다름
✅ ② derivation: derivation(도출/유도)은 일반 원리에서 추론으로 결론을 도출하는 과정으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ agreement: agreement(일치/합의)는 결론 도출이 아닌 의견이나 결과의 일치를 의미
❌ ④ evidence: evidence(증거)는 주장을 뒷받침하는 자료로 도출 과정 자체가 아님
det.tip: derivation = 도출, 유도. For the derivation of technical results — 기술적 결과의 도출을 위해

det.korean: 동사 justified를 수식하는 부사 형태가 필요. ultimate(형용사) → ultimately(부사)

det.korean: 새로운 의미의 과학은 뿌리(형이상학)를 고려하지 않고 줄기에서 열매가 어떻게 발전하는지만 생각하는 것이었다

❌ ③ by their self-evidence alone: 자명성만으로라는 표현은 정당화 방법에 관한 것이지 새로운 과학의 방향성이 아님
✅ ④ without regard to the roots: 원문 일치. 새로운 과학은 뿌리(형이상학)를 고려하지 않고 줄기에서 열매가 발전하는 것만 생각한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
